originality.rationale: Fused retrieval (SerpBase/OpenAlex/Crossref/OpenAIRE, no partial failure) finds only type-A hereditary work and ambient-freeness work. Full-text inspection of the three nearest primaries shows none states or implies the type-B restriction formula: Nakashima-Tsujie 2023 is type A only; Abe-Terao 2010 proves ambient freeness compatible with a non-free restriction; Abe-Tran-Tsujie 2021 concerns Shi-Ish interpolations in type A. No database, census, dual encoding, or stronger theorem covering cone extended Shi type-B restrictions or chi (t-1)(t^2-9kt+S(k)) was found. The B-specific half-level mechanism and parity-dependent constant are absent from prior work.

value.rationale: TARGET route: target asked for hereditary-freeness decision for cShi(B_l,k), 3<=l<=6, all k. The headline gives a uniform exact threshold: all rank<=2 restrictions free, and an explicit infinite family of rank-3 non-free restrictions with closed-form chi and strictly negative discriminant for every l>=3 and k>=1. This is a substantive disproof of hereditary freeness via a new infinite witness family, not a type error, vacuity, small-instance mismatch, lookup, or arbitrary parameter fact, so no ADMISSION_DEFECT. Honest limitation (no full flat-by-flat census at l=6) does not erase the independently retrievable exact invariant of a natural motivated object.

perplexity_final_check.rationale: Terminal paid search added 15 non-overlapping URLs but no decisive prior: 5 overlaps merely duplicated the base providers (Nakashima-Tsujie, Abe-Terao Shi-Catalan, Yoshinaga survey). Useful incremental recall was the flag-accuracy OWP (type-B Shi/Catalan accuracy, not hereditary) and the ERA Linial-Shi basis paper (type-A ambient bases), plus the MSJ talk abstract confirming the type-A-only scope; each was body-inspected and is close but does not cover the type-B restriction chi family. Remaining returns are general freeness surveys, workshop reports, meeting duplicates, and basis/thesis records about ambient bases or Catalan-B multiarrangements whose snippets state different theorems (explicit bases, integral expressions, Ziegler restrictions) with no x2-x3=0 flat, no (t-1)(t^2-9t+21) instance, and no hereditary type-B claim; HUSCAP thesis PDFs were attempted via curl and webfetch but the host TLS failed, and their snippets lack any shared base pair with the submitted flat/chi, so they were screened as not plausibly covering rather than left unresolved. No source states or implies the submitted formula, so originality PASS is preserved with no verdict change.
